<thought>The mass spectrum shows a dominant peak at m/z 100.0524. In ESI positive mode this is most consistent with the molecular ion (M⁺·) rather than an adduct, because the exact mass matches the calculated monoisotopic mass of C₅H₈O₂ (12·5 + 1.007825·8 + 15.994915·2 = 100.05243). This formula gives an integer double‑bond equivalent (DBE = 2), confirming a chemically plausible neutral molecule.</thought>
<final_answer>C5H8O2</final_answer>
